$comment: Samsung's published engine matrix, in one place, because it was in three and two of
them were wrong. vite.config.ts and services/capabilities.ts both said the 2020 sets
run Chromium 76. They run 69. Only floor.json had it right, and a fact stated three
times is a fact that drifts, which is the same reasoning that moved the row height into
Everything here is quoted from the Web Engine Specifications page, not inferred. The
hardware numbers are not here, because Samsung does not publish them: see floor.json.
'arrives' lists the things an engine gained that the one below it lacks, restricted to
what this application could plausibly want. It is the answer to 'can we use X yet',
which otherwise gets answered from memory.
